name: CVE-2026-110697

name: CVE-2026-107360
description: rubygem-safemode evaluates compound assignments in sandboxed Foreman/Satellite templates without Jail allow-list mediation: a template author invokes arbitrary no-arg methods on template objects (host deletion) and reads non-allow-listed state. name: CVE-2026-123039
description: Containerised PoC for CVE-2026-123039: the Check Point Gaia OS Dynamic CLI daemon publishes /tmp/dynamic_socket world-writable and authenticates no caller, so any local user escalates to root. Differential lab (affected vs patched), 4-mode PoC, 0day sweep.

name: CVE-2026-121653

A model of /WSStatusEvents runs on real Microsoft SQL Server; the differential, the three mitigations and an 0day sweep are captured.

name: CVE-2026-119618
description: Apache httpd mod_http2 (2.4.55-2.4.70) races on the connection allocator when assign_headers() writes the synthesised Content-Length: 0 into the shared stream table, corrupting the child heap. Containerised lab, stdlib HTTP/2 PoC, ASan and TSan evidence, 2.4.71 differential, workaround test, 0day sweep.

name: CVE-2026-119958

Differential lab with vulnerable and patched models, a wire-level LDAP proof of concept, and a sanitizer sweep of the patched model.

name: CVE-2026-126170

Differential 7.6.7 vs 7.6.8 plus a 72-case sweep.

name: CVE-2026-126148
